text: Voting machines were programmed to change votes in the 2020 election.

truthSource.label: CISA joint statement, Nov 12, 2020
truthSource.oneLine: Federal election-security officials found no evidence that any voting system changed votes; audits, recounts and more than 60 court rulings reached the same result.

lesson.tip: Hand recounts, audits and courts test whether machines changed votes. When a viral claim and the audits disagree, follow the paper.
